newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal govt budget deficit up 14 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Portugal govt budget deficit up 14 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: The central government budget deficit widened 13.8 percent over the first nine months of the year to 370.4 billion escudos ($2.4 billion), from 325.5 billion over the same period last year, the Finance Ministry reported on Monday.
The government has forecast a total state budget deficit of around four percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1996, down from 4.9 percent the previous year.
Central government current spending rose 6.6 percent to 3.04 trillion escudos compared with the same period last year, while current receipts rose 8.0 percent to 2.98 trillion.
The ministry said the deficit over the first nine months was in line with expectations. The figures took no account of profits made on Treasury operations, it said.
